problem.title: Scheduling shouldn't eat your evening
problem.body: Most places still run it off a spreadsheet and a group chat. So every week you're guessing who's free, missing that someone booked Friday off, and only finding out you went over on wages once payroll lands.
problem.old1: Build it in a spreadsheet, then photograph it into the group chat
problem.old2: “Can anyone cover Saturday?” — sent to twelve, one replies
problem.old3: Find out you overspent on wages only once payroll lands
problem.old4: Put someone on a day they'd already booked off
problem.new1: Drag names onto the week — copy last week and tweak in seconds
problem.new2: Publish once; everyone gets their shifts by text and in the app
problem.new3: Watch the wage total add up before you commit to the week
problem.new4: Skemaka flags time-off and availability clashes before you publish

how.title: How a week works
how.step1Text: They tap the days they can work from a link. No more asking around.
how.step2Text: Drag names onto days. The wage total adds up live, so an expensive week shows up before you publish it.
how.step3Text: One tap texts everyone their shifts and puts them in the app. Nothing on the fridge.

deep.buildTitle: Build the schedule by dragging names
deep.buildBody: Drop people onto shifts. Copy last week and tweak it. It's the bit you do every week — so it's built to be fast, not clever.
deep.costTitle: Know the cost before you publish
deep.costBody: Every shift adds to the running wage total. Spot the heavy Saturday while you can still change it — not when payroll lands.
deep.catchBody: Put someone on a day they're off, or one they marked unavailable, and Skemaka tells you — before you publish, not after the complaint.
deep.flag1: Thomas is on approved leave on Friday — but he's on the schedule.
deep.flag2: Emma marked Saturday as unavailable — but she's on the schedule.

faq.title: Questions owners ask
faq.q1: How do my staff get their shifts?
faq.a1: You publish, and everyone gets a text with their shifts. They can also open the free app or a web link — no setup from them, no printing.
faq.q2: Do staff need to create an account?
faq.a2: No. You add them, they get an invite link. They sign in with Google or Apple and they're in — most are set up in under a minute.
faq.a3: {currency}{price} per active employee per month. Deactivate someone for the season and you stop paying for them. No tiers, no setup fee.
faq.q4: Can I export hours for payroll?
faq.a4: Yes — the labour cost view exports to CSV with hours, wage, and total pay per person, ready for your bookkeeper or payroll software.
faq.a5: No. {days} days free with no card, then month to month. Cancel whenever — you keep access until the end of the period.
faq.q6: I run more than one venue.
faq.a6: Each venue is its own workspace today. Multi-venue under one login is on the way — get in touch and we'll set you up.
